kashika: आदिरन्त्येनेत्संज्ञकेन सह गृह्यमाणस्तन्मध्यपतितानां वर्णानां ग्राहको भवति, स्वस्य च रूपस्य। अण्। अक्। अच्। हल्। सुप्। तिङ्। अन्त्येनेति किम्? सुडिति तृतीयैकवचनेन टा इत्यनेन ग्रहणं मा भूत्॥
kashikaEnglish: The first sound together with the last marker forms a pratyāhāra (abbreviation for a sound class).
englishShort: A beginning letter, when combined with an ending इत् letter, stands for itself and for all the letters in between.
englishFull:
An initial letter with a final indicatory letter forms a प्रत्याहार covering all intervening letters.

**Example:** अक् = letters from अ to the इत् letter क् = अ इ उ ऋ ऌ (and their long forms).

**Why "final इत्"?**
Resolves ambiguity. सुट् could theoretically use the ट् of औट् (5 affixes) or the ट् of टा (7 affixes). Since pratyāhāras use final इत् letters, सुट् uses औट्'s ट् = first 5 case-affixes.
